name: ERO raised ninth-grade reading-comprehension scores by 0.9 standard-score points (effect size 0.09).
description: The end-of-ninth-grade GRADE assessment result has p=.002, with 2,672 ERO and 1,912 non-ERO students. It moved the reported national percentile from 23 to 25; 77% of ERO students still read at least two years below grade level.

name: ERO’s follow-up-year core-subject GPA estimate was 0.04 points and was not statistically significant.
description: The reported effect size is 0.05 with p=.061; the program supports ended after ninth grade. This is not proof of zero later effect, but it does not reproduce the program-year GPA result at the report’s 5% threshold.
